correctness.rationale: For every omitted vertex in part \(V_i\), selected-neighbor count is exactly \(s-s_i\). The open neighborhood is all vertices when the support meets at least two parts, while one-part support yields exactly the complement of that part. These cases prove the classification, coefficient formula, and minimum formula. Exhaustive literal-definition checks through order \(10\) agree.
